verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say it can issue both physical cards (for in-person employee spend) and virtual cards, each with attached controls. Its marketing describes 'instant virtual cards' with per-vendor spending limits, and funds carry amount and interval limits (daily, monthly, total) plus merchant restrictions. missing for 10: evidence that physical cards are issued or delivered 'in minutes' (only virtual cards are described as instant), and independent or hands-on confirmation of how fast issuance and limit setup really are.
